outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution image reconstructions (localizations, density maps, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel B, like A, shows representative super-resolution image reconstructions rather than an averaged quantitative plot.

The scatter plot of 'Number of clusters/cell' shows the mean ± SEM as a bar/line with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption ('means (±SEM) from individual cells...represented by gray dots').
The 'Cluster size' plot displays the mean ± SEM together with individual gray dots representing each cluster, consistent with the caption description.
The 'Mol. % into clusters' plot shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell, as described in the caption.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM image reconstructions and trajectory overlays, not an averaged quantitative plot.

The top histogram displays the full distribution of diffusion coefficients (not a summary average), and the bottom MSD plot shows individual molecule trajectories as separate lines, so raw/individual data are already fully visible rather than being collapsed into a single average with error bars.
Panel H presents representative trajectories, a kymograph, and example single-molecule trajectories, not an averaged quantitative plot.
